existing_finding_connections.relationship: Same original 059 Lens11 finding; new bounded 95e evidence and a conditional symbolic subcase do not create another counted unique finding or restore checkpoint 3821.
existing_finding_connections.trace: On transition into ragdoll, the client presentation system builds a rig-derived definition and buffered world-pose seeds. seed_bodies computes each mapped body's pose and finite-difference velocity; a kinematic body replaces its velocities with zero, but dynamic bodies retain the computed values. spawn_ragdoll calls RagdollGeometry::prepare before it queues any body; this is a meaningful all-dimension preflight. The preparation checks seed presence and scaled capsule dimensions, but not the fields of a present BodySeed. spawn_bodies subsequently queues the seed pose and velocities as native physics components. Physics ownership follows successful spawn preparation. This is a transient presentation path, not persistent tactical authority.
existing_finding_connections.rate_admission: AnimationSampleRate requires finite positive frequency and a finite positive reciprocal interval, so zero interval is excluded. The local PoseBufferConfig validator checks range relationships but imposes no maximum sample rate; its caller invokes that validator. Shipped content sets pose_buffer.sample_hz to 30.0 and maximum seed speed to 10.0 metres per second. No claim is made that any extreme configuration finishes loading or baking.
existing_finding_connections.symbolic_conditional_subcase: Suppose the configuration owner admits a finite pose-buffer frequency near 8×10^37 Hz and a dynamic body's two finite world positions differ by 5 metres in one component. The reciprocal is roughly 1.25×10^-38 seconds, still positive and above the f32 minimum normal. Under ordinary IEEE-754 f32 arithmetic the component division is about 4×10^38, beyond f32 maximum, and becomes infinity. Pinned glam Vec3 clamp_length_max computes length squared, compares it with the finite bound squared, and divides by its square root; infinity divided by infinity yields NaN, which remains NaN after multiplication by the bound and addition of finite momentum. Geometry preparation only observes that this seed is Some. This is a reasoned source-level case, not an executed program or fixture.
existing_finding_connections.native_source_scope: The exact Cargo.lock-pinned glam 0.32.1 archive supplies the inspected Vec3 length, scalar division, multiplication and clamp code. Feature resolution and platform-specific floating-point behavior have not been exercised. The precise affine decomposition, upstream world poses, native Avian admission and eventual result remain open.
existing_finding_connections.limits: Actual loading, clip baking and rig creation at that extreme rate may fail first; no producer has been shown to supply such a five-metre difference at that interval. No supported invalid seed, native physics effect, ordinary gameplay failure, alias closure or product result is established. Geometry failures still stop before body commands, and angular seeding has its own 10^-5-second denominator floor.
existing_finding_connections.connected_repair: If supported inputs expose the gap, define the completed seed admission at the ragdoll entry owner before any body/joint commands or Physics pose ownership; preserve geometry preflight, positive nonzero sampling interval, dynamic limb momentum and intentional kinematic anchor behavior. Determine native valid finite pose, rotation and velocity bounds from authoritative dependency and producer contracts.
existing_finding_connections.later_acceptance: Only after separate authorization for implementation and product validation, establish reachable producer cases and check valid seeds, rejection before partial island publication or ownership, and preserved normal live-pose momentum.
